derivation: or (Amos 9:7) כַּפְתּוֹר; apparently the same as H3730 (כַּפְתֹּר);
def: Caphtor (i.e. a wreath-shaped island), the original seat of the Philistines

occurrences.text: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)

Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith the Lord. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
